name: Ushigome-Yanagicho
tagline: Otemachi in 16 minutes and Shinjuku in 18 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 19 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 26.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 26.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 21.4 m to 34.7 m, a difference of 13.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 23 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 鉄友会柳町病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 神経研究所附属晴和病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
